title: Mutipath TCP: Use and Detection, (Mon, Nov 2nd)
description: A vulnerability (CVE-2026-98432) has been identified in the Linux implementation of Multipath TCP (MPTCP), a TCP extension introduced in 2020 to allow multiple network paths for a single TCP connection. MPTCP enables seamless switching between network interfaces and better bandwidth utilization. The vulnerability concerns the Linux MPTCP implementation as specified in RFC 8684. No specific exploit details or impact scenarios are provided. MPTCP is primarily observed in iOS/iPadOS and is detectable by inspecting TCP option 30 in network traffic.
